description: Demonstrate a human-reviewed multi-file C# change boundary for RetryBudget and its task definition. No model-generated code may be built or executed by this slice.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the two specified existing production C# paths may be modified or created in the detached candidate worktree.
The original main checkout remains untouched; the candidate stays at the same commit and is not attached to a branch.
Renames, deletions, symlink changes and unrelated modifications are rejected before any execution.
